title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.11
notes: Save your own looks: set up the animation, style, position and timing you like and save it as a preset to reuse on every project. Fixed a bug where clicking a built-in preset reset your colors, font and position. While captions are generating you can work in other apps: the SmartSubs icon shows the progress on the Windows taskbar (and in the Dock on the Mac native window), and you get a notification when your captions are ready. Privacy and security: the interface no longer loads fonts from Google, updates are only accepted from the official download locations, every release comes with a SHA-256 checksum, and the installer now shows the License Agreement. The Gemini guide explains Google's terms, including that users in the EU, Switzerland and the UK need a paid key.
